description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/

summary.one_liner: CLI-Anything is a toolkit that generates agent-friendly command-line interfaces for existing software, plus a package manager (CLI-Hub) for installing community-built CLIs.
summary.what_it_does: The repo provides two things: a 7-phase generator (run as a plugin or skill inside coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and others) that analyzes a software codebase and produces a Python Click-based CLI with a REPL, JSON output, undo/redo, tests, and documentation. It also provides CLI-Hub, a registry and package manager installed via pip (cli-anything-hub) that lists, searches, installs, updates, uninstalls, and launches published CLIs such as GIMP, Blender, LibreOffice, Zotero, and n8n. Generated harnesses are installed with pip and expose commands like cli-anything-gimp. Each harness ships a SKILL.md file so agents can discover its usage. The README lists many supported applications across creative, office, scientific, dev-tool, and communication categories. A cli-hub-meta-skill can be installed with npx skills so agents can find and install CLIs on their own.
use_cases: let an AI agent control GIMP, Blender, or LibreOffice from the command line
install a ready-made CLI for a desktop app via cli-hub
generate a new CLI harness for an open-source project
wrap a web service's API into one stateful command set
automate Zotero, Obsidian, or Joplin from scripts or agents
give coding agents a structured JSON interface to software
stack: Codex, Hermes, Reasonix, OpenCode, Copilot CLI integrations
notable: Generates a complete CLI for an application in a 7-phase pipeline (analyze, design, implement, plan tests, write tests, document, publish)
CLI-Hub registry lets agents and users install community CLIs with one command
Every harness ships a SKILL.md so agents can discover its commands
Works with many agent platforms, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and Hermes
Generated CLIs support structured JSON output and an interactive REPL
caveats: Some CLIs wrap real desktop software, so the upstream application (e.g. GIMP, Blender, LibreOffice) must also be installed
Windows users of the Claude Code plugin need Git for Windows (bash and cygpath) or WSL
Several platform integrations are marked experimental or community-supported, and some platforms are listed as coming soon
keywords: command line interface for ai agents
